properties.description: A first baseline and a clean check are recorded as what they are, rather than as changes that never happened. `set_artifact_checksum` gains a third disposition, `baseline_established`, for an artifact registered with no checksum getting its first one — the record moves and the code does not — and which disposition is available is a fact about the artifact rather than a preference: an accept against no baseline is refused, and a baseline_established that would MOVE an existing one is refused, so the new word cannot launder real drift past the two-sided accept. A recording reconcile stamps `Artifact.last_confirmed_at` on every artifact observed to still match, so a pass that found everything correct is distinguishable from a pass nobody ran; the confirmation ledger counts those toward examined, and reports first baselines apart from accepts because a first baseline is not a judgement anyone made.
properties.name: The ledger can say that nothing moved
